paragraphs: Mar bar Rav Idai: Chullin 63a; Yevamot 106a has Mar bar Idi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites Yevamot 106a for Mar bar Idi. The matching objection appears in the William Davidson digital text of Yevamot 106b; the supplied locator is retained.

The William Davidson digital paragraphs have Mar bar Rav Idai in Chullin 63a and Mar bar Idi in Yevamot 106b. Hyman’s supplied Yevamot 106a is retained alongside the existing note. These forms remain separate attestations; the comparison does not establish a single father, person, or correction history.
